{{Top|leg}}
'''Command Control Instructions''' were non-routine operational commands that rewrote a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] primary function either completely or partially. Inputting the instructions could be achieved by either a console, or by [[command control voice]]. Captain [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]] issued a command control insruction to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] ordering them to keep the identity of Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] a secret. Leia was furthermore designated a command control voice, and she gave R2-D2 further instructions to bring the stolen [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]] to General [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] at all costs. Both droids carried out their instructions during their time on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
